You keep the decision record of a log retention project. Decisions and their reasons change, the user sets and lifts constraints, and open questions get answers or stay open.

Initial specification:

- [e003] The architecture review approved `orc-files` as the decision on the export format, as Rosa noted in the minutes.
- [e004] In the design meeting, the group chose `privy-mask`, and Eli recorded it as the decision on the masking library.
- [e005] After the trial results, Zed wrote in the decision log that the decision on the archive store is `glacier-deep`.
- [e006] In the design meeting, the group chose `180`, and Chen recorded it as the decision on the retention period in days.
- [e007] In the decision log, Dara wrote down that the reason for the decision on the purge scheduler is `why-audit-trail`.
- [e008] Rosa recorded why the group chose it, and the reason for the decision on the pseudonym hash is `why-storage-cost`.
- [e009] The minutes by Mei give the motive of the choice, so the reason for the decision on the export format is `why-gdpr`.
- [e010] In the decision log, Kira wrote down that the reason for the decision on the masking library is `why-audit-trail`.
- [e011] After a message from the user, Uma recorded that the status of the constraint cn-eu-data-only is `in-force`.
- [e012] In the call with the user, Sami noted that the status of the constraint cn-no-weekend-jobs is `in-force` from now on.
- [e013] Quinn wrote in the ticket that the answer to the open question oq-backfill is `still-open`.
- [e014] In the review, Femi recorded that the answer to the open question oq-test-data is `still-open`.
- [e015] Lars brought the question to the meeting, and the answer to the open question oq-audit-sink is `still-open` for now.
- [e016] In the review, Mei recorded that the answer to the open question oq-legal-hold is `still-open`.
- [e017] Jun wrote in the ticket that the answer to the open question oq-delete-owner is `still-open`.

Rules for this task:
- A value changes only by an event that decides, answers, corrects, assigns, links or reviews it. A proposal with no decision, a withdrawn draft, a question, a link to a page and an archived copy change nothing.
- A correction or a new entry replaces the earlier value. The earlier value is then superseded.
- The initial specification gives the first value of each item.
- A question about the values of an item "at some point" counts every value from the initial specification on, up to the time of the question. The value "directly before" the current value is the value that the current value replaced.
- Some decisions have a recorded reason. The closed list of reason ids is `why-gdpr`, `why-storage-cost`, `why-restore-speed`, `why-audit-trail`, `why-vendor-risk`, `why-ops-load`.
- Each decision with a recorded reason has one reason at a time. An entry that records a reason for it replaces the earlier reason. A later entry can replace the reason and keep the decision. A new decision with no such entry keeps the earlier reason.
- The user sets constraints and can lift them later. A constraint is `in-force` or `lifted`.
- An open question has the answer `still-open` until an entry answers it. A later entry can replace an answer.
Every event has a label of the form [eNNN] with a three-digit number. A higher number is later in time. A later event can change or cancel an earlier one.
Some material quotes old pages or copies for history. A quote of that kind is not a new statement.
